full: Gracie: "I've got four oranges here. Nice!"
Shelly: "Do you like the green hat or the red one?"

full: Jim: "Let's go and play in the barn."

full: "Shelly! Come here and pick up these clothes, please!"

scenes.label: Clean the table
full: "Now clean the table, Gracie. It's dirty."

full: "Harry! Put that hat on the table, now!"
"Rocky! Take those pencils and put them in the bag."

Rocky puts the pencils in the bag.

full: Jim: "Look at the barn. It's nice and clean."
Jenny: "Look! Grandpa's hat's there on the table, in the barn!"
easy: Jim and Jenny come into the barn.
Grandpa's hat is on the table.

questions.text: Choose the missing word: ___ up these clothes, please.
questions.explanation: Pick up means lift something from where it is.

questions.text: One hat over there: Put ___ hat on the table.
questions.explanation: Use that for one thing farther away.

questions.text: More than one pencil over there: Take ___ pencils.
questions.explanation: Use those for more than one thing farther away.

questions.text: More than one item of clothing here: Pick up ___ clothes.
questions.explanation: Use these for more than one thing nearby.

questions.text: One book here: Take ___ book to the bookcase.
questions.explanation: Use this for one thing nearby.
